outcome: Molecular alterations (single-nucleotide variants, insertions/deletions) in placental chorangioma
Histological features of the placenta (chorangiosis, acute subchorionitis, chronic lymphocytic villitis)
cohort: The study included three cases of neonates delivered at term with placental chorangiomas, whose mothers presented with hypertensive disorder during pregnancy.
finding: Whole exome sequencing of placental chorangiomas did not reveal any significant pathologic variants, suggesting a reactive/non-neoplastic nature for these lesions, possibly related to compromised blood flow.
